name: Micro Center (US big-box, in-store pickup)
vendor: Intel / NVIDIA / ASRock / Sparkle / Acer / PNY
price_basis: ASRock Intel Arc B580 Challenger OC 12GB bare card, Micro Center in-store price, observed 2026-10-03, marked 'Available for In-Store Pickup Only'. Peer B580 SKUs: five refurbished boards at $179.99 each.
notes: Every GPU here is 'Available for In-Store Pickup Only' - there is no shipped channel, so this is not usable for remote buyers and stock is per-store. Two useful signals from one snapshot: refurbished Arc B580 boards sell at $179.99 against $309.99 for a new ASRock Challenger, a 42% discount that makes a used B580 a genuinely rational local-inference purchase; and the Arc Pro B60 24GB sits at $649.99 (down from $799.99) with the Arc Pro B70 32GB at $1,599.99. RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell is stocked in store at $15,899.99-$16,999.99, below both B&H and CDW, and a Threadripper PRO 9975WX system with an RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q is listed at $29,999.99.
